tldr: The Account Health page shows phone number, capacity, business account, and webhook details. An hourly job queues a health check for each Cloud API number not checked in 6 hours.
goal: Admins need to see the state of a WhatsApp number before messages fail.

story.heading: WhatsApp service stores Meta health data
story.body: The service saves Graph API health data on the channel. Authorization errors raise ApiError with an authorization flag.

story.heading: Hourly trigger now queues the health scheduler
story.body: The hourly trigger now queues the WhatsApp health scheduler. Before, it did nothing.

story.heading: Account Health page shows four configuration sections
story.body: The page shows phone, health, business account, and webhook sections. Embedded Signup authorization errors show a Go to Configuration action.

story.heading: Schema adds phone number health columns
story.body: The channel_whatsapp table gets 3 columns and 1 index. The columns store health data, its check time, and the last error.

story.heading: Health sync job syncs one channel
story.body: The job syncs one WhatsApp channel. It returns nil on API or argument errors.

story.heading: channel_whatsapp stores phone number health
story.body: The table stores the latest health data, its check time, and the last error per number.

story.heading: Scheduled sync keeps WhatsApp health data current
story.body: The hourly job selects Cloud API numbers not checked in 6 hours. It queues up to BULK_EXTERNAL_HTTP_CALLS_LIMIT syncs per run.

components.summary: Shows phone, health, capacity, business account, and webhook sections. Offers Go to Configuration on authorization errors.
The hourly trigger queues the WhatsApp health scheduler. The scheduler queues one sync per stale number.
Syncs Graph API health data into phone_number_health. Raises ApiError with an authorization flag on Meta errors.
Adds 3 health columns and 1 index to channel_whatsapp.

decisions.title: Refresh health data with a scheduled job
decisions.why: The job updates stored health data every 6 hours, without a page visit.
decisions.alternative: Read Meta on each page load only

decisions.title: Map Meta authorization errors to a typed ApiError
decisions.why: The page shows guidance for authorization failures, not Meta error codes.
decisions.alternative: Render the raw Meta error message

flows.title: Sync health data for one number
Queue health syncs for stale numbers
Queue the WhatsApp health scheduler hourly
